title: Page 193
transc:
HE Thayer Phila  Washn Oct 4 1864
Col A J Perry Quarter
Mr P period send all
steamers that can possibly be
spared to Washington immediately Answer
and give names of steamers
you send By order Q
M G signed Geo D
Wise Col & Q M


H. E. Thayer  Washn Oct 4th 1864
For Hon Wm K Kelly
P period Accept my thanks
I have written by mail
period Genl Marston is at
Wilsons landing on the James
river signed E M Stanton


HE Thayer Phila  Washn Oct 4th 1864 
To Col A J Perry
Q M Phila period Sufficient
vessels have been obtained None
need be sent from Phila 
By order Qr Mr Genl
signed Geo D Wise Col
